title: One branch for the Pearl game (main, every serving tree on it) and the rework ahead: the difficulty progression, the timing of waves, the count the frame holds, the progression and story line (owner, 2026-10-15); the first design question open
context: Owner, 2026-10-15: '8159 and 8162, let's unify everything to one branch, the one with the new enemies and no half-dot, and we will re-work 1) the difficult progression, 2) the timing of waves (since they are smaller), 3) confirm that we can have up to 1200 enemies as in our dev lab tests, 4) progression and story line.' Then: 'sync, then we will close all localhosts we are not using and re-open one with a fresh terminal'. main 383006a6 already held every side branch (pearl-default, bestiary-feel, bestiary, swarm-lab-pearl, pearl-enemies: 0 ahead); only refactor-round-2 (10 ahead, 42 behind, from pearl-enemies 8bf59188) carries unmerged work. Where the rework's knobs sit today: SECTORS (five fixed sectors: THE LANE, THE LONG LANE, THE CANYON, THE PRESS, THE SIDE WALL; threat 1.2 -> 2.2, pulse 16 -> 13 s, ladderStart 0 -> 5), SECTOR_HOLD until SECTOR_DOOR (7-8) with THE CANYON AGAIN before it, BACK_DOOR_SECTOR, BOTH_WALLS_SECTOR, SECTOR_GENERATOR (ladderCap 11); SECTOR_TIMING (pace 1.5, soft x2 at sector 1 up to x8, aliveBudget 2500, stall 20); CROWD_CAP (start 1500, min 400, max 3500, slowMs 36); PEARL_WAVES (scale .15 -> 1, pace .6 -> 1 over a breach's planned waves); PEARL_PACE (0.7-0.8 radii/s, every tier), PEARL_GAIT; ENEMY_SPEC hit points (the game's old ones under the Pearl bodies; the owner said he would raise them, 2026-10-13 round four). The story line past the handover is the sector briefs (two Isao lines each) and the debrief; nothing yet narrates why the swarm grows.
outcome: Done: the three serving worktrees (:8159 pearl-enemies, :8161 swarm-lab, :8162 bestiary) fast-forwarded to main, 56dbcd7e after the measurement's record; the side branches left in place, not deleted. Item 3 answered by 2026-10-15-pearl-crowd-measured-headed: a column of 1,200 holds the frame, a pile at the hull does not, and the pile sinks the crowd cap to its 400 floor, which holds every later wave (part of 'the waves are smaller'). PROPOSED, not decided: the rework starts with one question to the owner, which decides items 1, 2 and 4 together: what a sector should feel like under the Pearl set at the climb's end: (a) the lane fills (a continuous column, hundreds alive, the tank harvesting, hard cores forcing the shield; pulse and build-up tuned so the lane never empties), (b) pulses with gaps (distinct waves rising, crossing and dying, a breath between them to build and repair; fewer bodies, more pressure a wave), or (c) both by sector (early sectors as pulses, late sectors as the filled lane, the switch the story's own escalation). The recommendation on the table is (c). Servers after this entry: :8159 kept on main; :8160 (refactor-2), :8161, :8162 and :5174 (Jelly-Baby's vite) closed at the owner's word; the next stage opens one fresh server from a fresh terminal.
alternatives: Delete the merged side branches as part of unifying: not done; they are 0 ahead and cost nothing, and the owner can ask.
Rebase refactor-round-2 onto main now: not done; it is a separate playtest (wave clock, four modules out) and the owner said unify on the Pearl game, not merge the refactor.
Start the rework by tuning numbers (threat, pulse, scale): rejected for now; the three questions share one answer (the feel of a late sector), and tuning before it is guessing.
